    12  /-!
    13  ## Moore complex
    14  
    15  We construct the normalized Moore complex, as a functor
    16  `SimplicialObject C ⥤ ChainComplex C ℕ`,
    17  for any abelian category `C`.
    18  
    19  The `n`-th object is intersection of
    20  the kernels of `X.δ i : X.obj n ⟶ X.obj (n-1)`, for `i = 1, ..., n`.
    21  
    22  The differentials are induced from `X.δ 0`,
    23  which maps each of these intersections of kernels to the next.
    24  
    25  This functor is one direction of the Dold-Kan equivalence, which we're still working towards.
    26  
    27  ### References
    28
